ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the attached figure there are five circles with the same radius, arranged in the shape of the Olympic five rings: three circles in the upper row and two circles in the lower row. Adjacent circles in the upper row are tangent to each other; the two circles in the lower row are tangent to each other; each lower-row circle overlaps respectively with two adjacent upper-row circles. The grid in the figure shows that the distances between centers of circles that have positive-area overlap are all √2, and the other circles are only tangent or non-intersecting. Then reason: The radius of each circle is 1, so the sum of the areas of the five circles is 5π. Only four pairs of circles have positive-area overlap, so by inclusion-exclusion it is necessary to subtract these four identical lens areas. The overlap area of two circles with radius 1 and center distance d=√2 is 2 arccos(d/2) - (d/2)√(4-d^2). Substituting d=√2 gives the overlap area as 2 arccos(√2/2) - (√2/2)√2 = 2·(π/4) - 1 = π/2 - 1. Therefore the total covered area is 5π - 4(π/2 - 1) = 5π - 2π + 4 = 4 + 3π. So a=4, b=3, 10a+20b=10·4+20·3=40+60=100.

所以面积贡献为

(1+π/2)+(1+π/2)+π/2 = 2+3π/2。
总面积为
2(2+3π/2)=4+3π。
所以 a=4，b=3。
于是
